About AstraCasa

AstraCasa is a team of passionate innovators driven by curiosity, creativity, and a shared interest in space exploration and technology. We bring together our enthusiasm for science, engineering, and programming to tackle real-world challenges in human spaceflight.

For NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, we are developing ASTRA HEALTH, a health-monitoring solution designed to support astronauts during long-duration space missions.
